doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: early life and first bands
title: First band with brother Young Tuxedo, teaching himself drums and learning to read music
summary: Bailey's first band was with his brother Young Tuxedo; he taught himself drums and played about six years with Chris while learning to read music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: What was the first band you ever played with?
First band you played with, first dog with.
Young Tuxedo, my brother, young Tuxedo.
Oh, he's young, he's young. He's dead, dead now young, three months this month.
Oh, gee. What, who taught you to play instrument, the drums? Myself. Yourself? You just picked it up, huh? Yeah, picked it up.
And I was playing Chris, because I played him about six years.
And I, and I was learning how to read music, you know, everybody in the band read music.
